items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: And I did "Lonely Boy" with Paul Anka and "You Are My Destiny" with Paul Anka

ctx.x: Yeah, on "What's The Matter, Baby." That's it. And I did "Lonely Boy" with Paul Anka and "You Are My Destiny" with Paul Anka, and "Patricia," which we spoke about earlier; I told you how I suggested to set up the rhythm on the overdub.
Oh, yes. But say that again, because that's worth repeating.
